h: Obi cautions against harassing his supporters, says no one holds a monopoly on wrongdoing
p: Peter Obi has reportedly urged people not to harass his supporters, saying arrogance does not pay and that no one has a monopoly on wrongdoing. The NDC candidate spoke as the 2027 campaign heats up between the main parties.
more: Obi leads the NDC ticket alongside Rabiu Kwankwaso.
The party recently unveiled its 2027 campaign council.
The APC and ADC are also pushing their own campaigns.
